items.title: Anthropic turns Claude Artifacts into standalone desktop apps for macOS and Windows
items.excerpt: Claude Artifacts can now be installed as beta desktop apps on Mac and Windows, even with a free account; built in chat without code, they can use OS APIs and connectors to add menu bar items, notifications and transparent windows.
items.rationale: New product release that lets designers ship chat-built prototypes as installable desktop apps with native OS surfaces (menu bar, notifications, transparent windows) — a concrete new prototyping/delivery path, no code required.
